images.caption: Late morning whole milk did not cause the usual over 140 morning glucose spike that a mixed carb and saturated fat food typically causes during the morning. Thankfully, the insulin sensitivity is normal for the afternoon and evenings most days.

I have found that if carbs and saturated fat are combined, I get a higher glucose rise, so I am testing protein+carb alone and protein+fat alone to see what happens during the dawn effect morning hours.

Berberine timing test. for me, taking berberine at first bite was far more effective than 30-minutes ahead. Berberine has a short effectiveness window, so likely taking it at the first bite gave it more working time while food was being digested.
